baseline.quote: The project includes the direct planting of 2 clumping species of bamboo in the degraded forest reserve of Bandai Hills. Areas with remaining patches of forests are excluded from planting areas.

additionality.quote: The PP uses a specific forestry software which is presently under development to document the exact number of clumps planted, its survival status etc. At verification the audit team will have to verify the actual number of existing clumps by a sampling approach. At validation there was no detailed description, how this will be achieved. The PP needs to bear in mind, that the inventory as base of the carbon calculation needs to be verifiable.

baseline.quote: Conclusion: The auditor assessed the barriers described against provided documents, interviews conducted with government authorities, expert knowledge and observations made during the field audit and therefore confirms the existence of the barriers. 'Continuation of pre-project land use' as these are common practice is the only land use which is not prevented by any of the above described barriers. Hence, it is the most plausible baseline scenario.

baseline.quote: The baseline emissions for the project areas are those associated with negative land use change as the project areas undergo deforestation, forest degradation and further degradation of lands as indicated in the historical mapping. Under the conditions of the applied methodology, changes in carbon stock of above-ground and below-ground biomass of non-tree vegetation, dead wood, litter and soil organic pools are conservatively assumed to be zero for all strata in the baseline scenario: ΔCDW_BSL,t = 0 ΔCLI_BSL,t = 0 ΔCSHRUB_BSL,t = 0 ΔCTREE_BSL,t = 0 Therefore the baseline net GHG removal by sinks is zero: ΔCBSL,t = 0

additionality.quote: None of the describes activities can be compared to the proposed project activity in respect to objective, scale and complexity. additionality.quote: The project is currently designed as a carbon Project only. It is planting bamboo at a scale for which there is no current market for the raw material. As such the project is using a conservative timeframe for achieving cash flow breakeven, of greater than 10 years.

permanence_buffer.quote: Statements made in the non-permanence risk report can be confirmed as reasonable. Therefore, audit team confirms the significance of extreme weather as 'Insignificant', considering information from document review, interviews with farmers and experts and site visits/09/10/. Likelihood As confirmed during the onsite visit by interviews/09/ with farmers, droughts or other extreme weather events are unlikely for the project areas. Therefore, the audit team confirms the likelihood of this risk as estimated 'Once every 100 years or more, or risk is not applicable to the project area'. Score (LS) 0 is acceptable Mitigation The project has mitigated the risk of drought by carrying out pilot plantings over a five year period prior to the start of project activities, to ensure that both species are adapted to the project conditions. Furthermore, the project proponent carried out a replanting event to mitigate any effects and maximize stocking density in the project area. project. The mitigation measures as described were verified by the audit team during the field visit/09/10/. Mitigation rating of 0.5 is accepted, with no effect on the calculation.
